scope: Finite loopback motif viewer. Local intent proposals and host motion; no persistent service, avatar rig, or aesthetic validation.

calls.brief: Use sway as the returning motif. Across the four sections, use soft, clear, soft, clear accents in that order.
calls.system: Plan a 32-beat procedural dance at 120 BPM: four eight-beat sections in A,A,B,A order. Choose the A motif as sway (side-to-side) or pulse (up-and-down). B uses the other motif. Each section has four two-beat moves: rise, motif, motif, settle. All four moves in a section share its accent, soft or clear. Each section starts and finishes at rest. Honor the requested motif and the four chronological section accents, including final amendments. These are technical movement choices, not an authentic dance style. Return minified JSON only, no explanation. Return exactly two fields: motif (sway or pulse for A), and accents (array of four strings, each soft or clear). The host expands the score. No other fields.
